text: Song of ascensions. Much they pressed me from my youth, shall Israel now say:
Much they pressed me from my youth: also they shall not prevail against me.
They ploughing, ploughed upon my back: they made long to their furrows.
Jehovah the just cut the entanglings of the unjust.
They shall be ashamed and draw back all hating Zion.
They shall be as the grass of the roofs drying up before it was drawn out:
He harvesting filled not his hand; and he heaping together, not his arm.
And they passing by, said not, The praise of Jehovah to you: we praised you in the name of Jehovah.
